# cueson Delivery

This Project tracks delivery for `shruggietech/cueson` from repository bootstrap through the v1.0.0 stability gate.

- Issues are atomic outcomes with independent acceptance criteria and verification.
- Compatible issues may share a `Slice` when one implementation and review story remains coherent.
- `Stage` is the delivery lifecycle; the default `Status` field is intentionally unused.
- Milestones own release commitments.
- The repository constitution and `docs/project-management.md` define the operating contract.
